answer: Work waits on the tide until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the island of the next round. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the zenith of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
